notes.title: Roll7 announces NEW Multiplayer Action Title – Laser League!
notes.content:
WE MADE A NEW THING! A multiplayer thing with more lasers and neon lights than you can shake a stick at.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZTxNX2r7I9I
WHAT IS LASER LEAGUE?!

In Laser League, the exhilarating, high-octane contact sport of 2150, players battle against the opposition for control of nodes that bathe the arena in deadly light. Evading rival colored beams, teams attempt to fry their opponents with speed, strength and strategy. Special offensive and defensive abilities, as well as game-changing power-ups on the arena floor, provide an edge at the crucial moment. Like all great sports, it is accessible and immediately understandable, but rewards dedication with deceptively complex strategic possibilities.

Interested? We hope so, as we’re going to need your help in the Laser League BETA!

At Roll7 we are extremely greatful for the love and support our fans have shown us over the years from OlliOlli, OlliOlli2: Welcome to Olliwood and NOT A HERO - and we hope you’ll join the fight with us on our next venture.

What are you waiting for?! ENLIST FOR THE LASER LEAGUE BETA NOW:

www.laserleaguegame.com

Join the Forums and add to your wishlist here:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/570460/Laser_League/

Your feedback will be crucial to sculpting and cultivating the sport of the future and we’d love you along for the journey…

Thank you!

notes.title: NOT A HERO major update, performance improvements, windowed mode, DS4 official support, 4 new languages and Achievements!
notes.content:
As promised, our port of NOT A HERO on Windows is now ready for all you Bunnylord supporters to pick up in this latest update!

* Users who had framerate issues will find the new version much more stable, making those explosions even more glorious!
* The game now has a Windowed mode! Press Alt + Return to toggle between Windowed and Full-screen.
* DualShock 4 controllers now work properly in both the menus and in-game.
* NOT A HERO now comes in 4 new amazing flavours (French, German, Italian and Spanish) you can switch to these in NOT A HERO > Properties > Languages!

and the big one...

* 12 Steam Achievements for you all to pick throughout the game! Already played the game but just want these shiny new Achievements? No worries, we will be posting a small guide soon as to how you can get them all in record time!

v1.0 will still be available for all to play, this can be run by selecting "Run in safe mode (legacy)" on the version selector that appears when hitting "Play" within Steam.

Thanks for your continued support!

roll7
